description: Not cruelty. A parent who is warm on Tuesday and unreachable on Wednesday teaches a child that safety is not stable, which is the same lesson the war taught the parent.
energy_note: Learning the same thing without the war.

aspect: Role reversal - the child manages the parent
description: Children of traumatised parents commonly take on monitoring: reading the mood, managing siblings, keeping the house quiet. It produces capable adults who cannot rest.
energy_note: Competent at nine, exhausted at forty.

description: Families frequently decide not to tell the children. The children grow up sensing a large unspecified thing, and often construct a worse version of it than the truth.
energy_note: A secret they can feel the shape of.

description: No shouting in the house. No doors. No fireworks at new year, ever. He learned these before he learned why, and he keeps them now, in a house of his own, in a country his father never saw.
energy_note: Enforcing a dead man's air-raid rules in Toronto.

aspect: It is not deterministic, and saying so matters
description: The Halabja three-generation study and the Holocaust literature both find elevated risk, not certainty. Many descendants are fine. The dataset records elevated probability, not a verdict on any individual.
